title: Eco-friendly methods for the synthesis of N-acyl pyrazole derivatives with luminescent properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12698-12703
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08527B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Eliza Świętczak, Michał Rachwalski, Adam Marek Pieczonka
The study presents a comparison of green synthetic methods for N-acyl pyrazoles, which show solid-state luminescent properties due to the AIE phenomenon, using aromatic carbohydrazide derivatives and 1,3-diketones as starting materials.
